commitBoundary: Separate guarded atomic per-file replacements, not transactional; both postconditions verified

betweenWritesFailureCheck.boundary: simulated conflict after first file replacement and before second
betweenWritesFailureCheck.secondFile: intervening writer preserved; rejected by expected-byte guard
betweenWritesFailureCheck.mechanism: Same guarded per-file replacement as real update; temporary owned files only
betweenWritesFailureCheck.limitations: No cross-file rollback/transaction or filesystem failure injection; no interprocess compare-and-swap lock
